تستمطرون (form X)
# تَسْتَمْطِرُونَ (tastamṭirūna) /tas.tam.tˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# تُسْتَمْطَرُونَ (tustamṭarūna) /tus.tam.tˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
